sloka: भार्गवस्य सुतां विद्धि देवस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ।अरजां नाम राजेन्द्र ज्येष्ठामाश्रमवासिनीम् ।। ७.८०.८ ॥
transliteration: bhārgavasya sutāṁ viddhi devasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ।arajāṁ nāma rājendra jyeṣṭhāmāśramavāsinīm ।। 7.80.8 ॥

translations.english: O king of kings, know me to be Araja by name, the eldest daughter of the divine sage Bhrigu, whose deeds are pure, and who dwells in the hermitage.
